Help.purposeTitle: What you can do on this website
Help.purposeText: The website of the East Kazakhstan State Archive is for information: you can find details about the archive and its branches, search the online catalogue, view open digital copies, online exhibitions and Memory Archive materials. You cannot submit requests or order certificates here — use the egov.kz portal for that.
Help.navItems: Catalogue — search for documents · Memory Archive and Exhibitions — the region's history in documents · Branches — addresses and directions · Help and FAQ — answers to common questions · “Ask the archive” AI assistant — tells you where to look.
Help.schemeHint: Click a level to see what it means

archive.title: Archive
archive.text: The institution that keeps the records. The East Kazakhstan State Archive has a main building and branches in several towns of the region.

fund.title: Fonds
fund.text: All records of one organisation or one person. For example, the fonds of the Ust-Kamenogorsk Titanium and Magnesium Plant or a writer's personal fonds.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.text: A list of files within a fonds. Inventories group files by year, record type or department.

unit.title: File
unit.text: A folder of documents on one matter — a storage unit. The sheets in a file are numbered.

document.title: Document
document.text: A specific record: minutes, a letter, a photograph or a map. Every document on the site has a page with its description.

searchSteps.s1: Type in your own words: “photos of Ust-Kamenogorsk in the 1960s”. The site recognises the document type, place and period.
searchSteps.s2: Refine the results with filters: type, period, place, digital copy, topic.
searchSteps.s3: Know the reference code? Paste it into the search box — the document will open.
searchSteps.s4: Share a link to the results — the filters are saved in the page address.

Help.cipherTitle: How to read a reference code
Help.cipherText: The reference code is the exact address of a document in the archive. It is cited in research and when you visit the reading room.
Help.typesText: The catalogue includes photographs, written documents, maps and drawings, audio and video recordings, personal papers and records of organisations. Thematic selections are in the Memory Archive and Exhibitions sections.

access.DESCRIPTION_ONLY: The description is published; the document can be consulted in the archive reading room.
access.RESTRICTED: Access is restricted by the law of Kazakhstan (for example, personal data); only the description is online.

Assistant.disclaimer: Helps with the website and catalogue. Does not accept applications or requests.
Assistant.greeting: Hello! I can help you find open documents, photos and maps, and tell you branch addresses and where things are on the site. Ask in your own words.

Assistant.example3: Where is the Ridder branch and what are its hours?

roleIntro.SUPER_ADMIN: You have full access: content, users, activity log and settings.
roleIntro.SITE_ADMIN: You manage pages, content, branches and staff accounts.
roleIntro.EDITOR: You create materials and publish them after moderator approval.
roleIntro.ARCHIVIST: You maintain the electronic catalogue: fonds, inventories, files, documents and scans.
roleIntro.BRANCH_ADMIN: You maintain the information and news of your branch.
roleIntro.MODERATOR: You review materials before publication and publish approved ones.
